scripts.//api: The API client is generated, never hand-written. api:generate runs from the committed openapi.json snapshot and is wired as a pre-step on every command that compiles TypeScript, so a fresh clone cannot build against a missing or stale client. api:fetch refreshes the snapshot from a running backend; the backend's OpenApiSnapshotTest fails if the committed one falls behind.
scripts.api:generate: openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.json -g typescript-angular -o src/app/core/api/generated -c openapi-generator.config.json
scripts.//build: ng build, then the security policy and headers written into the result. Reads AUTOX_API_BASE_URL, AUTOX_STORAGE_ORIGINS and AUTOX_SITE_URL from the environment; see scripts/build.mjs.
scripts.//i18n: French is the source locale, so there is nothing to translate yet. This extracts the i18n-marked strings for the day a second locale is added.
